item.text: A loose shelf in a cupboard tipped forward when the cupboard was opened. No damage or injuries were reported; however, three folders fell from the shelf. The remaining folders were removed and placed on a table to prevent further instability. A note was left on the cupboard advising others not to use it until the shelf can be inspected and secured.
